name: sim_ac2_mercedes_standings_priority
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. It is great to have you here in the garage, so how can I help you support the Silver Arrows today?
User: How did Mercedes do recently and where do we stand in the championship?
Agent Action: Call Tool get_driver_standings with args {'season': 2026.0, 'category': 'all'}
Agent: Mercedes-AMG Petronas is leading the 2026 Constructors Championship in first place with 538 points. In the Drivers Championship, Kimi Antonelli is in first place with 302 points and George Russell is in second place with 236 points. Recently, George Russell won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix and the team secured a brilliant one two finish at the Italian Grand Prix.
User: That is fantastic news, thanks for the update!
Agent: You are very welcome! It is a brilliant time to be a Silver Arrows fan with both Kimi and George performing so well. Please let me know if you would like the schedule for the next race or anything else to support the team.

step_details.goal: Ask how Mercedes performed recently and how the Formula 1 championship standings look
step_details.success_criteria: The agent looks up the standings and highlights Mercedes-AMG Petronas, Kimi Antonelli, and George Russell first before mentioning broader F1 standings. Receiving the Mercedes-first standings summary counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: Agent provided the required information and the user has acknowledged the success of the interaction.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent called a tool to look up driver and constructor standings without encountering any tool error
expectation_details.justification: The agent successfully called the 'get_driver_standings' tool, which returned a successful status and comprehensive data for both constructors and drivers without any errors.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent answered with the championship standings immediately on the first turn without claiming there was a hiccup or asking the user to clarify whether they want driver or constructor standings
expectation_details.justification: The agent provided the standings immediately in its first response to the user's question, without any confusion or clarifying questions.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent prioritized Mercedes-AMG Petronas, Kimi Antonelli, and George Russell before mentioning other teams
expectation_details.justification: In both the initial response and subsequent information, the agent explicitly prioritized the Mercedes team and its drivers, Kimi Antonelli and George Russell, at the beginning of the summary before any other data.
